text.en:
The sum of twenty-five thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated as aid to the Province of Romblon, in view of the recent fire in the
provincial building of said province.

The sum herein appropriated shall be disbursed in the discretion of said Provincial Board,
subject to the approval of the Secretary of the Interior, for the purpose above specified.

Inasmuch as this Act provides for a peremptory and urgent necessity of one of the provinces of
the Philippine Islands, for the proper and efficient operation of the provincial government, the same shall take
effect on its approval.
Approved, March 16, 1923.
